ownership: Factory owns undelivered partial source; host OpenExisting and reverse activation lifetime own delivered source. Close+join dispatch before source disposal even if stop fails.
instrumentation: Trusted optional token observations, fully awaited post-SQL hook, lifecycle strategy; no payload or credential logging.
review_boundaries: Trusted configureHost must establish TLS, cryptographic JWT trust and default authentication; selected handler existence alone attests none of those settings.
Injected authority collaborators remain caller-owned; the security module does not dispose arbitrary injected ports.
source_revision_after_review: Only XML documentation added to record the two reviewed ownership/configuration limits.
